school.name: Bronx School of Law and Finance
school.overview: We are a school that many know by word of mouth.  We enroll siblings, cousins, neighbors, and friends, and we are known for being welcoming and loving.  We have a rigorous instructional program, and students select a major in either Law or in Finance.  Come visit our Trading Floor or our model Court Room and follow our Instagram page at bxlsf_03 to learn more! As a Future Ready school, the mission of the Bronx School of Law and Finance is to provide students with the necessary skills to pursue employment and/or higher education through the introduction to careers in law and finance"
school.bus: Bx1, Bx10, Bx2, Bx20, Bx7, Bx9, BxM1, BxM18, BxM2, M100

programs.name: Bronx School of Law and Finance (X28A)
programs.description: Students will be exposed to law and finance for their first two years. Students will select a major course of study for junior and senior years.
